summary: Instagram Autopilot (FASE INSTAGRAM) - Complete backend and frontend testing. All endpoints working correctly with MOCK_MODE=true, CONNECTION_STATUS='NOT_CONNECTED', META_REAL_CALLS=0. Frontend admin page renders correctly with all status pills, KPIs, buttons, and settings. Telegram collections verified untouched. Public site regression passed.

backend_issues.notes: All backend endpoints working perfectly. Zero Meta API calls as expected.

frontend_issues.notes: All UI elements render correctly. All buttons clickable and functional. Public home page loads successfully (timeout was due to networkidle wait, but page rendered correctly as shown in screenshot).

passed_tests: Backend: Admin login and JWT authentication (401 without token on all endpoints)

Backend: GET /status returns all required fields (MOCK_MODE=true, CONNECTION_STATUS='NOT_CONNECTED', operational=true, AUTO_SCHEDULER_ENABLED=false, active=false, ITALY_AUDIENCE_MODE=true, META_REAL_CALLS=0, SECRET_MEDIA_USED=false, INSTAGRAM_REAL_POST_DONE=false)
Backend: GET /status settings (posts_per_day=2, schedule_times=['13:00','20:30'], timezone='Europe/Rome')
Backend: GET /status queue (total>=1, order list present)
Backend: GET /status schedule (next_slot.slot_id starts with 'instagram_' and ends with 13:00 or 20:30)
Backend: POST /test-connection returns CONNECTION_STATUS='NOT_CONNECTED', MOCK_MODE=true, META_REAL_CALLS=0, no access token in body

Backend: POST /publish-now?dry_run=true returns status='DRY_RUN', post_type in (PHOTO_POST, REEL_POST), caption in Italian with 'link in bio', no 'onlyfans' or 'http', hashtags 3-6, media[0].side='PUBLIC', no 'segret'/'secret' in path

Backend: POST /publish-now (real, 2 calls) returns status='MOCK_PREPARED', payload.media_type in (IMAGE, REELS), logs show MOCK_PREPARED with mock=true, queue position advanced, last_published populated, META_REAL_CALLS still 0
Backend: POST /skip returns status='MANUAL_SKIP', skipped creator name
Backend: No duplicate creators within same cycle (verified in queue.order done flags)
Backend: PATCH /settings validation - rejects invalid time '25:00' (422), invalid timezone 'Mars/Olympus' (422), non-Italy timezone 'America/New_York' (422), posts_per_day > schedule_times (422)
Backend: PATCH /settings valid update - accepts valid body, sorts schedule_times ['13:00','20:30'], returns 200
Backend: POST /start returns enabled=true with note about master switch being off (AUTO_SCHEDULER_ENABLED=false)
Backend: POST /pause returns enabled=false
Backend: Telegram collections untouched - queue.position and cycle_number unchanged before/after Instagram actions (read-only verification via /api/admin/telegram-autopilot/status)
Frontend: Admin login successful at /admin (age gate dismissed)
Frontend: Sidebar navigation contains 'Instagram Autopilot' link to /admin/instagram-autopilot
Frontend: Page data-testid='instagram-autopilot-page' renders correctly

Frontend: Status pills render - ig-state='IN PAUSA', ig-scheduler='DISABILITATO', ig-connection='Meta: NOT_CONNECTED', ig-mock='MOCK_MODE: TRUE', ig-italy-mode='ON', ig-meta-calls='Chiamate Meta reali: 0'
Frontend: KPI ig-kpi-current shows 'x / N' format (4 / 10)
Frontend: KPI ig-kpi-today shows 'orari 13:00 · 20:30 (Europe/Rome)'
Frontend: Button ig-dry-run ('Anteprima caption') works - ig-preview appears with ig-preview-caption containing 'link in bio' and hashtags, toast success
Frontend: Button ig-test-connection works - toast shows 'Meta: NOT_CONNECTED · MOCK_MODE'
Frontend: Settings form ig-settings-form present with ig-posts-per-day=2, ig-schedule-times='13:00, 20:30', ig-timezone='Europe/Rome', switches ig-use-photo/ig-use-video/ig-use-ai
Frontend: Rotation list ig-rotation has 10 items (ig-rotation-item)
Frontend: Log entries ig-log-item present (3 entries showing MOCK PREPARATO)
Frontend: Button ig-publish-now works (clicked once with window.confirm accepted) - toast 'Mock preparato: ...' and log shows 'MOCK PREPARATO'
Regression: Public home https://secret-side.preview.emergentagent.com/ loads successfully (creator cards visible, no console errors)
Regression: /admin/telegram-autopilot page structure intact (no errors, page renders)
